source_title: Daytime Emmy Awards 2026 Photos: Best Of The Red Carpet
source_excerpt:
James Gunn On Margot Robbie Returning To DCU In ‘The Suicide Squad’ Role: “I Don’t Know If She Wants To Play Harley Again; She May Be Over That”
Harry Shum Jr. On Reprising Roles In ‘Glee’ Revival & ‘Crazy Rich Asians’ Series: “Would Love To Try & Find A Way To Make It Work”
Jennifer Lawrence Addresses Being Bravo Superfan Who Uncovered ‘Summer House’ Reunion Leaker: “I Don’t Mind My Own Business”
The 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards celebrate the best of daytime television, and the Hollywood Palladium is the place where the celebration takes place.
CBS leads the award show nominees, with The Young and the Restless with 18 and Beyond the Gates with 15. ABC’s General Hospital has 13 nominations.
NBC’s The Kelly Clarkson Show leads talk shows with 10 nominations in its final year on the air.
RELATED: How To Watch The 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards
Genie Francis is being honored tonight with NATAS’ Live Achievement Award, as are this year’s Gold Circle and Silver Circle recipients.
Presenters and appearances are expected to include Eva zu Beck, Danielle Chang, Crystal Chappell, Matthew Hoffman, Sunny Hostin, Derek Hough, Pati Jinich, Star Jones, Michael Jr., Lesli Kay and Joe Lando.
RELATED: 2026 Daytime Emmys: Complete List of Winners
Other stars set to appear at the Daytime Emmys include Eva LaRue, Katelyn MacMullen, A Martinez, Greg Mathis, Delon de Metz, Juliet Mills, Keke Palmer, James Preston, Paul Telfer, Tamara Tunie, Nischelle Turner, Susan Walters, Alicia Leigh Willis and Andrew Zimmern.
RELATED: ‘The Celebrity Traitors’ Season 2 Crowns Winner On BBC One
Scroll through the photo gallery below to see all the looks from the 2026 Daytime Emmys red carpet.
